ext_desc.message: Auto refresh & reload any page on a timer. Monitor pages for changes and get notified.

opt_only_active.message: Refresh only while this tab is active

opt_preserve_form.message: Preserve what I typed in forms

opt_save_rule.message: Auto-arm this site when I return

note_bg_floor.message: Background tabs refresh at most every 30s (a Chrome limit) — foreground tabs hit your exact interval.

monitor_help.message: Get a desktop notification when this page changes — even if you close the tab.

onb_tagline.message: Set it. Forget it. Never hit reload again.

onb_step1.message: 1. Open any page you want to keep fresh — a dashboard, live scores, an auction.

onb_step2.message: 2. Click the Auto Refresh icon, pick an interval, hit Start. A live countdown begins instantly.

onb_step3.message: 3. Want an alert instead? Choose Monitor for changes, pick an element, and close the tab — we'll still watch it.

onb_trust.message: Free forever. No account. No ads. No tracking. Background tabs refresh at most every 30s (a Chrome limit); foreground tabs hit your exact interval.
